references.label: Right scoop
references.description: Scoop behind the inline drops; it starts Mission Multiball and locks balls during it.
references.context: The right scoop starts Mission Multiball and can lock its balls.

references.label: Left scoop
references.description: The other Mission Multiball lock scoop.
references.context: The left scoop locks a Mission Multiball ball.

references.label: Captive Ball
references.description: Timed Mission Multiball Jackpot shot after a three-ball-phase scoop lock.
references.context: The Captive Ball scores the lit Jackpot or Double Jackpot.

references.label: M target
references.description: Timed Super Jackpot target after the Captive Ball Jackpot.
references.context: The M target scores the Super Jackpot after the Captive Ball Jackpot.
